## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon saved [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) by catching her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard. [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) was also present during the picnic where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoyed a boat ride and ice cream.
